verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents next-business-day direct deposit when payroll is run by 5:00 PM, and same-day deposit when run by 7:00 AM, which exceeds the story's next-day/2-day bar. Employees enter their own direct deposit details online, and auto payroll can run on direct deposit, so the founder doesn't need to write checks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of deposit timing, and clarity on which plan tiers include next-day versus same-day deposit.
